# Godwin Idiovo

> Media buyer, funnel builder, and automation specialist helping businesses scale with traffic, conversion funnels, and backend automation built into one engine.

Godwin Idiovo offers full-stack growth execution: paid media, conversion funnel design, backend automation (CRM, workflows, integrations), and email marketing & lead nurture.

## Services

- [Media Buying](/services/media-buying): Paid traffic acquisition optimized for ROAS.
- [Conversion Funnels](/services/conversion-funnels): End-to-end funnel design from click to booked call.
- [Backend Automation](/services/backend-automation): CRM, workflows, and integrations that run themselves.
- [Email Marketing & Lead Nurture](/services/email-marketing): Email sequences that warm leads and convert.
